summary: Accelerate DevProjectAnalyzer and DiskAnalyzer with fixos-native measurement and 7d activity checks

delivery.outcome: Accelerate DevProjectAnalyzer and DiskAnalyzer using fixos-native tree and batch measurements, git and source activity checks, and bounded log walks, replacing unbounded rglob walks and 30-day hardcoded threshold.
nonGoals: No changes to deletion safety boundaries or deletion authority
No destructive actions without explicit confirmation

architecture.decision: 1. Update DevProjectAnalyzer._get_dir_size to use fixos.diagnostics.native_scan.measure_tree first with bounded du fallback, and inspect native mtime and git activity in _get_last_modified. 2. Replace hardcoded 30-day threshold in DevProjectAnalyzer.get_summary() with DEV_PROJECT_OLD_DAYS. 3. Replace unbounded rglob('*') in DiskAnalyzer._get_oldest_file_date and _get_newest_file_date with bounded os.walk and native_scan.measure_tree. 4. Add unit regression tests in test_project_scanner.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit via protected PR if needed.

validation.evidence: DevProjectAnalyzer uses native scan and git activity.
DiskAnalyzer oldest and newest file dates use native scan and bounded walks without rglob.
All focused unit tests pass cleanly.
